messages:
ryan: RC candidate rc-2026-03-22-b (sha: a7c9f2) artifacts uploaded. proposing change window 18:00-19:00 PT. no DB migrations. preparing release notes and pins.
lina: quick note — contact-summary prompt tweak included, should reduce hallucinations on long threads.
kevin: infra: runtime-pack on dedicated pools is at 2026.03.10; we need to pin to 2026.03.18 for this RC (contains memory scheduler fix).
ryan: suggested promote command: `/promote rc-2026-03-22-b --pin runtime-pack@2026.03.18 --pin tokenizer@3.2.1`
qa-bot: regression smoke started. ETA ~12m. Tests: prompting-suite, embed-failures, tokenization-regress.
ops-sheriff: i'll take sheriff for the window. waiting for QA green before canary start.
kevin: noted — prepping canary autoscale profile and KV warm plan for conversation-service.
qa-bot: smoke: all critical checks passed. regression: 95/100, 4 low-priority failures (tokenization edgecases). attaching logs.
lina: low sev token deltas look acceptable; happy to proceed with pins.
ryan: deploy-bot, please generate canary and preflight.
deploy-bot: Preflight results: artifacts verified, config diff clean, pins present. Canary plan: eu-west-1 3% -> 20% -> 100% over 25m. KV warm recommended for /v1/embeddings. Links: https://grafana/redwood/canary/5876543210
kevin: starting small canary infra changes now (min-cpu bump in canary autoscale).
ops-sheriff: start canary when ready.
deploy-bot: Canary started -> eu-west-1 3% (target 8m).
ryan: watching latency & error graphs. ping if anything odd.
kevin: seeing a latency tail on conversation-service instance svc-12 at 18:05:42; CPU not high but IO wait is elevated.
lina: logs show repeated tokenizer cache misses from that instance. weird.
ops-sheriff: error rate creeping up: 0.6% (threshold 0.5%). advise pause and investigate.
ryan: pause canary. hold promo.
deploy-bot: Canary paused. Holding at 3%.
kevin: running quick rollback-sim: traffic back to rc-2026-03-22-a will be clean. prepared rollback commands.
ops-sheriff: let's rollback to rc-2026-03-22-a. No partial promo. Proceed with rollback steps.
deploy-bot: Initiating rollback: reassigning traffic to rc-2026-03-22-a, disabling new canary instances, reverting route tags.
kevin: reverted routes and scaled down canary ASG. disabling tokenizer cache new feature flags.
ryan: promo aborted. i'll open a hotfix branch rc-2026-03-22-b-hotfix for tokenizer cache guard + runtime tweak.
qa-bot: QA will rerun failing tokenization tests against rc-a and rc-b locally and post traces.
lina: adding note to release PR: pin runtime-pack@2026.03.18 and tokenizer@3.2.1; blocked until cache fix.
ops-sheriff: thanks all — retiring sheriff for this window. please re-originate when fixes are in and tests green.
kevin: logs and flamegraphs uploaded to #build-failures. entry: high iowait on svc-12 during canary.
ryan: final: change window closed early. release notes unchanged except pins. Will re-run origination after hotfix and fresh QA. :thumbsup:
